title: Kagamine Len — Putting Feelings Into Action〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wanna try that thing one more time?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You mean that battle we did...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got to play a really amazing song for Miku-P, so I wanna get revenge on you now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're talking pretty big.
But can you walk the walk?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because you'd get all mopey if I don't.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Also, I'm not going easy on you.
I've been doing some secret training.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hold on, Rin...
You're not overdoing it again, are you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I did say “secret training”, but I haven't really been doing that much! I-If you don't believe, just ask MEIKO, okay?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sounds good!
Just play what your opponent plays, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! And since I started last time, you can start this time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You sure?
You might lose right off the bat.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's not happening.
I'm definitely gonna win this time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, not bad. Your training's really paying off.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Told you so!
Okay, my turn!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(That was good.
It sounds a lot like the one I just played, but it flows a little differently. This won't be easy.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! No way! You can play that?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Too bad. Now it's my turn.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I thought I had it...!
I was fine through most of it...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you really were spot on for the majority of it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you became too anxious after your ace in the hole failed. I'm guessing you would've played it fine under different circumstances.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Len, again!
I'll start this time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No way! I'm gonna clobber you this time!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem to be enjoying themselves, so I say we leave them be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah. Let them have their fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Also, we shouldn't interrupt them, so let's give them some space for now.
